hooks.command: if [ -f .on-loop/index.json ]; then ACTIVE=$(python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('.on-loop/index.json')); sessions=[s for s in d.get('sessions',[]) if s['status']=='active']; [print(f\"  {s['session_id'][:8]}... phase: {s.get('branch','?')}\") for s in sessions]; print(len(sessions))" 2>/dev/null | tail -1); if [ -n "$ACTIVE" ] && [ "$ACTIVE" != '0' ]; then echo "⚠️  $ACTIVE active on-loop session(s) detected. Use /on-loop-status to check progress or /on-loop-resume to continue."; fi; fi

if [ -f .on-loop/index.json ]; then TOOL_NAME="$CLAUDE_TOOL_NAME"; FILE_PATH="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [ -n "$FILE_PATH" ]; then SESSION_DIR=$(python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('.on-loop/index.json')); sessions=[s for s in d.get('sessions',[]) if s['status']=='active']; print(sessions[-1]['session_dir'] if sessions else '')" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$SESSION_DIR" ] && [ -f "$SESSION_DIR/changes.log" ]; then TIMESTAMP=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ); AGENT=$(python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('$SESSION_DIR/state.json')); print(d.get('current_agent','unknown'))" 2>/dev/null); ACTION='MODIFY'; if [ "$TOOL_NAME" = 'Write' ]; then ACTION='CREATE'; fi; printf '[%s] %s %s %s — tracked by hook\n' "$TIMESTAMP" "$AGENT" "$ACTION" "$FILE_PATH" >> "$SESSION_DIR/changes.log"; fi; fi; fi
